title: crataegus oxyacantha var. horrida
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha var. horrida, commonly known as the Prickly Hawthorn, is a variety of hawthorn tree that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and reduce the risk of heart disease due to its high levels of antioxidants and flavonoids. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus oxyacantha var. horrida include cardiotonic, vasodilatory, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular natural remedy for cardiovascular issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids (such as quercetin, kaempferol, and isorhapontigenin), oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
